instruction: Build a Pivot Table in Sheet2 summarizing total revenue by Product, with product names displayed as row labels.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a pivot table in Sheet2 with product revenue totals. Verified data has 12 unique products. Evaluator checks that Sheet2 contains at least 10 product entries in the pivot table.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only checks if product names appear anywhere in Sheet2, not if a pivot table structure exists
No verification that revenue is summarized - instruction requires 'summarizing total revenue by Product' but getter doesn't check revenue values at all
No verification that products are displayed as row labels - getter just searches for product names in any cell location
Weak detection logic: uses iter_rows(values_only=True) to find product names anywhere, which would pass even if data is plain text, not a pivot table
Missing pivot table structure verification - LibreOffice Calc pivot tables (data pilot tables) have specific structures that should be validated
Incomplete coverage: evaluator only verifies one aspect (product count) out of three requirements (pivot table structure, revenue summarization, row labels)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Check for actual pivot table existence using openpyxl pivot table APIs or LibreOffice Calc data pilot table structures
Verify that revenue values are present and associated with each product (check both row labels and data values)
Validate that products appear specifically in row label positions of a pivot table, not just anywhere in the sheet
Check that the data structure matches pivot table format: product names in column A as row labels, revenue totals in adjacent columns
Consider verifying revenue totals are correct by comparing against source data
Add verification that Sheet2 contains actual aggregated/summarized data, not just copied source data
